captured_from: wicked-estate-mcp-0.12.0 (description re-stamped at 0.21.0, #211: relation echo + flows); cursor added at 0.28.0 (#279 paging); depth default 24
description: Transitive dependencies of a symbol (forward-reachability on Calls+Imports edges). Optional relation='flows_to' traces semantic value flow from producer to consumer; the reply echoes the effective `relation` ('dependency' | 'flows_to'), any other value is an error, and in flows_to mode a `flows` array classifies each hop (the rows under `dependencies` are then the consumers). Answers 'what does this symbol depend on?' — the complement of BlastRadius. Use to understand the full dependency chain before a refactor or to build a change-impact picture from the dependency side. The answer is paged: while `next_cursor` is non-null, call again with `cursor` set to it to get the rest; the answer is complete only when `next_cursor` is null.

cursor.description: A previous reply's `next_cursor`: returns the next page of the same answer. Keep calling while `next_cursor` is non-null; the answer is complete only when it is null.

depth.description: Maximum hop depth (default 24 = max: the default answer is the deepest walk).

relation.description: Optional relation selector. Use 'flows_to' to trace semantic value flow from producer to consumer; omit for default dependency lineage.

symbol.description: Symbol ID whose transitive dependencies to enumerate.

name: Lineage
